en.title: Rusted Gears and the Steam Engine of Prayer
en.premise: In a world choked by thick clouds and relentless sandstorms, I survive as a junk dealer, living in constant fear of running out of fuel and steam. But my life takes a turn when I unearth an 'undelivered letter' from an ancient delivery drone buried in the dunes. The letter leads to a 'lost village' wiped from every map—a sanctuary rumored to house a legendary perpetual motion machine. Armed with nothing but a modified steam bike filled with scrap and sarcasm, I set out on a journey to uncover the truth that was lost to time.

zh.title: 锈蚀齿轮与祈祷蒸汽机
zh.premise: 在一个被厚重云层与沙尘暴封锁的世界中，我作为一名拾荒者，每日都在对燃料与蒸汽耗尽的恐惧中挣扎求生。直到某天，我从一台埋没在沙海中的旧时代快递蒸汽无人机里，回收了一封“无主遗信”，这彻底改变了我的命运。信件所指引的方向，是一个从地图上“消失的村庄”——那里据传是沉睡着传说中永动机的圣域。我跨上那辆装满破铜烂铁与冷嘲热讽的改装蒸汽机车，踏上了寻找失落真相的旅程。
